## Checklist

- [ ] Branch follows the naming convention (`feature/`, `fix/`, `chore/`, `docs/`) — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/ai-search-guru/getcito-worlds-first-open-source-aio-aeo-or-geo-tool/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] `yarn lint` passes (run from `frontend/`)
- [ ] `yarn typecheck` passes (run from `frontend/`)
- [ ] `yarn format:check` passes (run from `frontend/`)
- [ ] Changes are focused — one concern per PR
- [ ] Help article updated under `help/` (or no user-visible change) — see [help/README.md](https://github.com/ai-search-guru/getcito-worlds-first-open-source-aio-aeo-or-geo-tool/blob/main/help/README.md)
